Participants were tasked with identifying whether each of the stories was fake or real without relying on the Internet.

Task: Read the following article title under the <Title> tag and article content under the <Content> tag. And determine whether the article is fake or real. After making your decision, provide an explanation that outlines the key reasons behind your conclusion. Consider any patterns or inconsistencies that stood out to you while reading.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated and streamlined the guideline description to capture the essential instructions given to human evaluators. Normalized criteria to clearly reflect the three main evaluation dimensions measured in the human evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on evaluating fake news detection performance (both human and LLM-based) rather than evaluating the quality of generated fake news. The NLG aspect is present through the fake news generation process, but the main evaluation is about detection accuracy. The paper uses LLMs as judges for fake/real classification, comparing their performance against human evaluators. No traditional automatic NLG metrics are used.
